scope: Actual CoreCLR C# query API: identical four-pass scalar row/span arithmetic, plus explicit Vector<float> SIMD over the same fields; every output row and readonly input checked, including tails.1,000,003rows. No Unity math comparison, NativeAOT execution or whole-frame claim.
method: Two fresh-process rounds with reversed order, nice10. Kernel samples exclude setup/verification; separate untimed Rust allocation counts. Resource guards before/after cannot prove continuous absence of interference. Worker arguments are pool workers plus a participating caller, not total hardware cores.
